cells.original_text:
Eligibility is reviewed at renewal. The limits below apply
to each household category. All values are fictional.
Annual limits by household
Household 2024 2025
One person 40 45
Two people 65 70
Three or more 80 90
Unit: fictional units per year. These are illustrative limits.
A renewal requires a fresh review; approval is not automatic.
Use the fictional service portal for application details.
